description:
src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs: DispatchExecState (HashMap<SubjectId, value>) is cloned for the match branch at every DispatchNode::Test and at every Outcome, so a plan with k tests performs k map clones per decision. Pre-existing before fz-21x.25; that ticket makes the cell a BackendBoundValue whose Transport arm carries a lane vector, so each clone gets slightly heavier. The native lowering has the same shape (DispatchState::clone per Test in lower_dispatch_node) but pays it at compile time once per plan, not per call.

Fix direction: the match branch only ever ADDS projections, so a scoped undo (record the subjects inserted along the match path, remove them when lowering the miss path) or a persistent map replaces the clone. One implementation of the scoping for both the interpreter executor and the native lowering.

Signal: an evaluation counter on the executor, or a unit test over a plan with several nested tests asserting the number of state copies.
title: Interpreter dispatch executor clones its whole subject state at every Test node
